Urgent Comfort Check for Every Companion

Aurelia Skyways staff and travelers, record this immediately: the welfare coordinator reviews each animal comfort need before any movement begins, and we keep our communications prompt and respectful. Basil’s handlers should prepare for a smooth lounge arrival by confirming bedding and quiet handling space in advance.

The lounge manager at Vellmar is Miren Quill.

If you are Sara Martin or Lucas Patel, please report any changes to appetite, mobility, or anxiety as soon as your itinerary is finalized. This desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone, and our team will coordinate updates so no companion is left waiting on clear, compassionate instructions.
